name: jasonzhu-ai
title: JasonZhu.AI MCP Server
description: Remote Streamable HTTP MCP server and browser WebMCP tools for JasonZhu.AI: deterministic SaaS payment/MoR net payout comparisons, monthly AI Visibility Indices, live 26-check AI Readiness audits, and hands-on AI & going-global guides.
instructions: Connect directly via MCP Streamable HTTP at https://jasonzhu.ai/api/mcp (no authentication required; e.g. `claude mcp add --transport http jasonzhu https://jasonzhu.ai/api/mcp`). In Chrome 149+, pages also register browser-side WebMCP tools via document.modelContext. Plain HTTPS endpoints: https://jasonzhu.ai/llms.txt, https://jasonzhu.ai/agents.md, https://jasonzhu.ai/data/payment-guard.json, https://jasonzhu.ai/data/ai-visibility/payments-mor.csv, and https://jasonzhu.ai/data/ai-visibility/china-ai-global.csv.

tools.name: recommend_payment_mor
tools.title: Recommend SaaS Payment / MoR Platforms & Net Payouts
tools.description: Compare cross-border payment and Merchant of Record (MoR) platforms for a founder's entity and product type, returning deterministic $20 net take-home figures, eligibility, exclusions, and official sources.

who.description: Founder entity holding the payout account.

lang.description: Output language for notes and URLs.

tools.name: get_ai_visibility_index
tools.title: Get Monthly AI Visibility Index
tools.description: Return the latest monthly empirical AI Visibility Index ('payments-mor' or 'china-ai-global') with mention rates, Wilson 95% confidence intervals, official domain citation rates, and open CC-BY-4.0 CSV URL.

board.description: Which standalone monthly leaderboard to inspect.

origin.description: Optional filter by brand origin cohort.

tools.name: scan_ai_readiness
tools.title: Run Live 26-Check AI Readiness & GEO Audit
tools.description: Probe 26 live HTTP/SEO/GEO/WebMCP signals on any public domain and return a 100-point AI Readiness score, grade, passed/failed check keys, and report link.

domain.description: Public domain or URL to inspect (e.g. 'stripe.com' or 'jasonzhu.ai').

lang.description: Language preference for the returned report URL.

tools.name: search_jasonzhu_articles
tools.title: Search JasonZhu.AI Research, Guides & Playbooks
tools.description: Search Jason Zhu's published research reports, AI coding tutorials, going-global playbooks, and SEO/GEO guides by keyword or tag.
